stage1.impression: A moody, warm, well-composed long view down a timber-and-concrete bar, close to something a magazine would shoot. It still reads as CG: the furniture and Orb lamps repeat as identical copies marching down the room, the floor's hard stool shadows and the bright wedge of light on the concrete wall look like a sun patch rather than one night-time spot, and the hanging globe is a near-black blob, so the eye has no clear hero. It reads more as a specific place than a catalogue bar (record wall, altar pair, globe), but it would not run as the opening spread.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as see-through smoked cast acrylic with glowing polished disc edges, not a black silhouette: region [1240,20,1740,560] lum_median >= 20 with lum_p95 >= 90
Its shadow on the concrete wall must read unmistakably as the globe's slotted-disc shadow, not a window patch
The altar pair must read at a glance as tinted acrylic horns: speaker regions lum_median >= 45 without blowing their white batts
The Orbs must read as smoked acrylic around a frosted liner, not as plain white balls (centre lum_median 120-170, not ~193)
Break the visible repetition of identical chairs, glasses and Orbs down the banquette with varied props and placement
Lower-right banquette must hold detail (crush below 5 %)

defects.what: Mother EARF reads as a dark, almost opaque sphere (lum_median 7.5, p95 35); disc edges and see-through acrylic barely register; it does not read as the centrepiece
Hard bright wedge on the concrete wall reads as daylight through a window, not the globe's shadow at night; the slotted pattern is not legible
Altar pair small, grey and flat (lum_median ~30-32), white batts hot (p95 ~220-227) while the tinted cabinets disappear; reads as grey boxes with a white woofer
Orbs on every table identical, glowing flat white (r201 g192 b182) like plastic balls; same rocks glass in the same place on each table: repeated copies
Identical steel-shell chairs repeated down the aisle in near-identical orientation
Hard, crisp multiple stool shadows across the floor from an unexplained raking source; floor is a flat even grey with little polish or wear
Banquette foreground underexposed (lum_median 13.4, crush 11 %), upholstery reads as a black mass
Ceiling fir reads as a uniform orange wood texture without checks or darker end grain; slightly over-saturated (r82 g41 b20)
The large frosted screen on the right is a flat purple-grey rectangle with a soft blob; reads as a blank panel rather than an even frosted glow

changes.problem: Mother EARF, the frame's centrepiece, is a black silhouette; the smoked acrylic's transparency and polished edges do not show.

change.setting: Mother EARF hard spot + an added low-power back/rim light (lighting designer's kicker) grazing the disc edges from behind and above
change.from: one hard spot 140 W from [6.24, 2.75, 3.32], cone 30 deg, nothing behind
change.to: keep the hard spot, add a narrow 2500 K spot ~40 W from behind the globe (toward the back of the room, above beam height) aimed at the disc edges so the 25 mm polished edges light up and the wall/beams behind glow through the smoke

changes.expected: Disc edges read as glowing lines, the timber behind is visible through the smoked discs; region brightens without losing its dark smoked character.

changes.problem: The globe's shadow on the concrete reads as a sun patch through a window, breaking the night-time coherence.

evidence.measured: lum_median 59.6, p95 157.6 in a hard wedge; slot pattern not legible

change.to: about 90 W, cone 22 deg, moved so the beam crosses the whole globe square-on to the wall (e.g. from [6.24, 0.4, 3.3] -> wall projection centred behind the globe), so the full circle of slotted discs is cast on the concrete

changes.expected: A circular, slotted shadow of the globe on the wall, warm, peak around 120-140, clearly the globe's and not a window.

changes.problem: The altar pair is under-lit and grey; only the white batts/woofer read, the tinted cabinets vanish.

change.to: add a soft 2700 K backlight behind each speaker (~20 W area lamp in the niche, aimed at the cabinet's rear face) so light passes through the tinted acrylic; reduce the altar spots to ~130 W so the batts no longer near-clip

changes.expected: Cabinets glow smoky through their walls; speaker region median rises into the mid 40s-50s, batts below 215 p95.

changes.problem: The Orbs glow flat neutral white and read as plastic balls rather than smoked acrylic over a frosted liner.

evidence.measured: lum_median 192.8, r201 g192 b182: near white

change.to: 0.15 W, glow 0.004, liner emission at 2400 K; frosted liner roughness up so the glow is even and the smoked outer shell is visible as a darker rim

changes.expected: Orbs read as warm amber-smoke globes with a visible darker shell edge, centre ~130-160.

changes.problem: Identical props in identical positions on every table and identical chairs in identical angles say 'render'.

evidence.measured: same rocks glass to the left of each Orb on four tables; chairs at [900,900,1350,1600] in matching orientation

change.from: 3 rocks, 2 coupes, 5 napkins, 2 votives, 1 matchbook, 1 coat; chairs aligned
change.to: leave one table empty, put a half-drunk coupe and a matchbook on the nearest, a record sleeve and two glasses on the second; rotate each chair by a different 5-25 deg and pull one out; hang a coat on the nearest chair

changes.expected: No two tables read alike; the room looks used, not instanced.

changes.problem: The foreground banquette crushes to black.

change.from: exposure 4.0, no fill on the banquette
change.to: keep exposure 4.0, add a very soft 2700 K bounce (large area lamp, ~3 W) from camera-left low, or lift the toe in the grade by +0.15 stop in shadows only

changes.expected: Upholstery channels and the banquette's fir rail read; still dark.

changes.problem: Crisp multiple stool shadows across the floor come from a raking source that is not a visible practical, and the floor is a flat grey.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 191.5 in hard-edged bright bands; lum_p5 8.5

change.to: 24 W, cone 28 deg with a softer spot blend so pools land on the counter and fall off on the floor; floor finish slightly more polish/sheen variation

changes.expected: Pools of light on the counter top, softer shadows on the floor, floor peaks drop toward 150.

changes.problem: The ceiling fir is a uniform, over-saturated orange texture without checks or darker end grain.

change.from: 3000 K white balance; even fir texture
change.to: 3200 K white balance; fir with darker oil, visible checks and darker beam ends

changes.expected: Ceiling reads as old Douglas fir, less orange, more varied.

out_of_scope.request: Give Mother EARF or the Orbs a more saturated tint so the frame has one clear colour accent
out_of_scope.why: The configuration is Smoke and the products' colour is fixed; the colour must come from light through the smoke, not a new tint.

out_of_scope.request: Bring the altar pair larger in frame / closer
out_of_scope.why: Would require moving the altar or the camera framing the whole room; the room layout is fixed and this frame's purpose is the full room from the door.
